mapper.select: SELECT child.* FROM ai_subagent_agent_binding binding INNER JOIN ai_subagent definition ON definition.id = binding.subagent_id INNER JOIN ai_agent child ON child.id = definition.local_agent_id WHERE binding.agent_id = #{agentId} AND binding.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND binding.enabled = 1 AND binding.deleted = 0 AND definition.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND definition.source_type = 1 AND definition.enabled = 1 AND definition.deleted = 0 AND child.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND child.deleted = 0
